thread:
maya: Heads up — noticed console quota dashboard shows traffic attributed to "route_hint" but our TS SDK will rename header to `x-rd-route` in the next minor. That'll break attribution for any dashboards using the old header. Thoughts on a short-term remap in Console + a graceful SDK fallback?

liam: Oof. Which header exactly? we have a few variants floating around (route, route-hint, X-Route-Hint).

maya: The current reported attr is `x-route-hint` lowercase. New TS PR changes to `x-rd-route` (to align with proxy). We can make SDK emit both for a release but want to avoid long-term duplication.

sasha: For rollout UX — console can add a mapping layer so incoming `x-rd-route` maps to the existing route dimension. That buys time. But we should show a deprecation banner for owners so they can switch alerting.

rahul: SDK side: adding a dual-header emit is trivial in TS and Go. Py is trickier because it reuses requests.Session wrappers. Example patch (TS):

```ts
// before
headers['x-rd-route'] = routeHeader
// after
headers['x-rd-route'] = routeHeader
headers['x-route-hint'] = headers['x-route-hint'] || routeHeader // fallback for console
```

rahul: We'll put that behind a feature flag default-on for 2 releases, then flip.

liam: Console mapping + banner sounds good. Two asks from platform side: 1) we need a migration window + cutover date in the banner, 2) telemetry events for requests that hit the mapping so we can measure adoption.

maya: Agreed on both. Can Console emit a `route_header_mapped` metric? count per value so we can see how many requests are still using legacy header.

sasha: Yep. I'll add a new tile in the quota dashboard that shows mapped vs native. Quick mock: left chart = tokens by route header (native), right = tokens mapped from legacy header. Also add a tiny blurb in the console settings UI about how long mapping will persist.

liam: For quota attribution we also need to ensure the ledger key is stable. If mapping simply renames, ledger should continue to use the canonical `route` key. No ledger key churn.

rahul: Good point. We'll make SDK keep canonical route value identical. No changes to route hash algorithm.

maya: One more: some customers use internal proxies that lowercase headers. We should canonicalize header names server-side (case-insensitive) and console mapping should match on header value, not raw header name.

liam: Already in infra planning — header canonicalization is on by default, but I'll confirm no edge cases for dash/underscore variants.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canaries for console mapping are starting in us-west-2 — 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m window. Watchboards: console-quota, route-mapping-errors.

maya: Perfect. Action items:
- rahul: dual-header emit PRs for TS/Go + note for Py (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- sasha: console mapping + banner + mock (ETA Thurs)
- liam: confirm ledger won't change and verify header canonicalization (ETA Wed)
- maya: craft customer comms draft for deprecation (ETA Fri)

liam: I'll also wire a telemetry event `route_header_mapped=true/false` into the sampling pipeline so we can slice by customer.

sasha: UX note — the banner should link to docs describing exact header names & examples including proxies that lowercase headers.

maya: Thanks everyone. If we get the dual-header out quickly we can avoid any surprise quota blips. :thumbsup:

liam: 👍

rahul: PR up shortly, will tag here.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50% in us-west-2 (10/20 hosts), no errors so far.

maya: I'll paste the customer comms here when draft is ready for review.
